description: For each carrier in the logistics tracker, compute the total number of shipments, the number of delivered shipments, and the average delivery time in hours. Delivery time of a shipment is the time from its first 'shipped' event to its first 'delivered' event. Carriers with no delivered shipments must appear with delivered_shipments = 0 and avg_delivery_hours = NULL. Output columns: carrier_name (STRING), total_shipments (INT64), delivered_shipments (INT64), avg_delivery_hours (FLOAT64, 1 decimal). Sort by carrier_name.

event_ts.description: UTC scan timestamp; scans can be repeated

edge_cases: Duplicate 'delivered' scan must not create a second delivery or change the delivery time
Shipment that was shipped but not delivered counts in total_shipments only
Carrier with no shipments at all must still be listed with zeros
Shipment with a delivered event but no shipped event has no measurable delivery time
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining shipped events to delivered events row-by-row fans out on repeated scans, inflating counts and skewing the average
FM3: COUNT(*) after joining events counts events instead of shipments
FM1: INNER JOIN to delivered events drops carriers with no deliveries
